name: Peceptron_Mult
summary: A multi-layer perceptron (MLP) neural network-based Expert Advisor that uses supervised learning to predict price direction and generate buy/sell trading signals. The EA trains its neural network on historical price features and executes trades based on the network's forward-pass predictions, combining machine learning classification with automated order placement.
summary_zh: 基于多层感知器(MLP)神经网络的自营交易EA，通过监督学习预测价格方向并产生买卖信号。该EA利用历史价格特征训练神经网络，并根据网络前向传播预测结果自动执行交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用多层感知器(MLP)神经网络作为核心策略引擎，属于机器学习交易类别。入场条件基于神经网络的前向传播输出——当网络输出超过买入阈值时开多仓，低于卖出阈值时开空仓。网络输入特征通常来自价格序列的技术指标（如移动平均、动量、波动率等），通过归一化处理后输入网络。训练阶段使用历史数据通过反向传播算法更新权重，属于有监督学习框架。出场条件通常依赖固定止盈止损或反向信号触发平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA支持多种手数设定方式，但神经网络本身不直接控制仓位大小。资金管理方面，需要关注训练数据过拟合风险以及神经网络在市场状态切换时的适应性下降问题。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) neural network as its core strategy engine, classifying it firmly in the machine learning trading category. Entry conditions are determined by the neural network's forward-pass output—opening long positions when the output exceeds a buy threshold and short positions when it falls below a sell threshold. The network input features are typically derived from technical indicators computed on price series (such as moving averages, momentum, and volatility), which are normalized before being fed into the network. The training phase uses historical data with backpropagation to update weights, operating under a supervised learning framework where labeled price direction data guides the optimization. Exit conditions generally rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or reverse signal triggers for position closing. Position sizing is configurable through input parameters, but the neural network itself does not dynamically control lot sizes. Money management considerations must account for overfitting risk on training data and the network's degraded adaptability during regime shifts in market conditions.

parameters.name: InputLayerSize
parameters.description: 神经网络输入层节点数，决定特征维度
parameters.description_en: Neural network input layer nodes, determines feature dimensions

parameters.name: HiddenLayerSize
parameters.description: 隐藏层节点数，影响模型复杂度
parameters.description_en: Hidden layer nodes, affects model complexity

parameters.name: OutputLayerSize
parameters.description: 输出层节点数，通常为分类数
parameters.description_en: Output layer nodes, typically equals number of classes

parameters.name: LearningRate
parameters.description: 学习率，控制权重更新步长
parameters.description_en: Learning rate, controls weight update step size

parameters.name: TrainPeriod
parameters.description: 训练周期，用于历史数据回测训练的K线数量
parameters.description_en: Training period, number of bars for backtesting

pros: 基于机器学习方法，理论上能捕捉非线性价格模式，比传统指标策略更具适应性
神经网络具有自学习能力，可通过历史数据训练不断优化权重参数
多层感知器结构允许灵活调整网络深度和宽度，适应不同市场特征复杂度
有监督学习框架提供明确的训练目标和可量化的预测精度评估
输入特征可灵活选择和组合，支持多维技术指标融合分析
pros_en: Machine learning approach can theoretically capture non-linear price patterns, offering greater adaptability than traditional indicator-based strategies
Neural network has self-learning capability, continuously optimizing weight parameters through historical data training
Multi-layer perceptron architecture allows flexible adjustment of network depth and width to match varying market complexity
Supervised learning framework provides clear training objectives and quantifiable prediction accuracy evaluation
Input features can be flexibly selected and combined, supporting multi-dimensional technical indicator fusion analysis
cons: 神经网络容易对历史训练数据过拟合，实盘表现往往远逊于回测结果
市场状态切换时模型泛化能力差，训练期外的数据分布变化导致预测失效
缺乏动态止损和自适应仓位管理，风险控制手段单一
网络训练计算开销大，在MT5平台上实时训练可能导致延迟
黑盒模型难以解释交易逻辑，不利于策略诊断和优化调整
未考虑滑点和点差对短线交易的影响，实盘成本可能侵蚀利润
cons_en: Neural networks are prone to overfitting on historical training data, with live performance often significantly worse than backtesting results
Poor generalization during market regime shifts, as changes in data distribution outside the training period cause prediction failures
Lacks dynamic stop-loss and adaptive position sizing, resulting in monolithic risk control measures
Network training is computationally expensive, and real-time training on the MT5 platform may introduce latency
Black-box model makes trading logic difficult to interpret, hindering strategy diagnosis and optimization adjustments
Does not account for slippage and spread impacts on short-term trading, where live costs may erode profits
improvements: 加入正则化手段（L1/L2正则化、Dropout）防止过拟合，并引入交叉验证评估模型泛化能力
实现动态止损和自适应仓位管理，如根据ATR调整止损距离或根据预测置信度调整仓位大小
增加市场状态识别模块，在不同市场环境下切换或重训练模型
引入特征重要性分析和特征选择流程，减少噪声特征对模型的干扰
添加滑点、点差过滤和交易成本估算，使策略更贴近实盘环境
improvements_en: Add regularization techniques (L1/L2 regularization, Dropout) to prevent overfitting, and introduce cross-validation to evaluate model generalization
Implement dynamic stop-loss and adaptive position sizing, such as adjusting stop distance based on ATR or position size based on prediction confidence
Add a market regime identification module to switch or retrain models under different market conditions
Introduce feature importance analysis and feature selection pipeline to reduce noise feature interference with the model
Add slippage, spread filtering, and trading cost estimation to bring the strategy closer to live trading conditions

risk_points: 神经网络过拟合风险高，回测与实盘表现差距可能很大
缺乏市场状态切换检测，模型在趋势反转时可能连续亏损
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，极端行情下可能造成超预期损失
训练数据窗口选择不当会导致模型学到错误模式
risk_points_en: High neural network overfitting risk, with potentially large gap between backtesting and live performance
Lacks market regime shift detection, model may incur consecutive losses during trend reversals
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit do not account for market volatility changes, potentially causing unexpected losses in extreme conditions
Improper training data window selection may cause the model to learn incorrect patterns
